public_rationale: The firm audience comparison is supported by Apptopia's January figures: ChatGPT held 45.3% of the measured daily app-user market, compared with Grok's 15.2%. Both figures use the same provider and comparison period. This supports the ordinary reading that Grok had a smaller audience, within the measurement's coverage. The hedged prestige remark is not graded.
limitations: This is support for the audience clause only.
App audience estimates do not establish exact worldwide, all-channel user totals.
No benchmark ranking or popularity measure has been substituted for prestige.
